ranking_rule.order: executor row order (graph storage order); no scoring
ranking_rule.dedup: by normalized cause text (NFKC + casefold + whitespace collapse); first occurrence fixes the rank; action ids are the ordered union of mapped action ids across that cause's rows
ranking_rule.unmapped_causes: keep their rank slot with cause_id 'unmapped:<first 8 hex of sha256 of normalized cause text>'; never fabricate a canonical equivalence
ranking_rule.unmapped_actions: omitted from action_ids; graph element ids never enter the input
ranking_rule.abstained: true iff the retrieval returns zero ranked results; abstention is observed, never tuned

chain_export_query: MATCH (ca:Cause)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(act:Action) OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Fault)-[:HAS_CAUSE]->(ca) OPTIONAL MATCH (ec:ErrorCode)-[:INDICATES]->(f) RETURN elementId(ca) AS cause_element_id, ca.description AS cause_text, elementId(act) AS action_element_id, act.action_name AS action_text, collect(DISTINCT ec.code_id) AS error_codes ORDER BY cause_text, action_text

graph_count_queries.triggers_components: MATCH (c:Component)-[:TRIGGERS]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS count
